// Moore state machine, one output (walk_X) and two inputs (bump_X).
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right
);
    reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= nextstate;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; nextstate = bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b01 : 2'b00); end
            2'b01: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; nextstate = bump_right ? 2'b11 : (bump_left ? 2'b00 : 2'b01); end
            2'b10: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; nextstate = bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b01 : 2'b10); end
            2'b11: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; nextstate = bump_right ? 2'b11 : (bump_left ? 2'b00 : 2'b11); end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

// Moore state machine, simple Lemmings brain: switch direction when bumped
// in the opposite direction.
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; state <= bump_left ? 2'b10 : 2'b00; end
                2'b01: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; state <= bump_right ? 2'b00 : 2'b01; end
                2'b10: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; state <= bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b00 : 2'b10); end
                2'b11: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; state <= bump_right ? 2'b11 : (bump_left ? 2'b01 : 2'b11); end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
